$comment: Schedule 23 SLAs, exactly as defined by Claude_Data/SLA_Expected_Results.xlsx: rules and holidays from its README tab, targets from its 'Monthly summary' tab, 23B statements from its 'Mapping for 23B' tab. Rate (Completed) = Met / (Met + Missed) and PASS/FAIL is judged on it; Rate (incl. Open) also counts open items past their deadline as not met.

slas.label: 23A
slas.name: Policy issue
slas.statement: Issue Policy Immediately / at a Later Date. Created before 15:00: closed the same business day. Created 15:00 or later: closed the same or next business day.

workflowTypes: Issue Policy at a Later Date

slas.label: 23B NUL
slas.name: Non-unit-linked policy alterations
slas.statement: 96% of non-unit-linked policy alterations processed by EOD following day of receipt.

slas.label: 23B UL
slas.name: Unit-linked transactions
slas.statement: 98% of unit-linked transactions received by 3 pm processed same day. Overall = Steps 1-3 met / Steps 1-3 completed.

slas.label: 23B UL Step 1
slas.name: Unit-linked EBQ transactions
slas.statement: EBQ transactions mapped UL merged the same business day (EBQ carries no time, so no 3 pm cut-off).

slas.label: 23B UL Step 2
slas.name: Withdrawal approvals
slas.statement: Each withdrawal matched to a 'Workflow for Withdrawal Approval' on the same policy; workflow Created Date vs the withdrawal's last-status time, using the 3 pm rule.
slas.monthBasis: Workflow created month (last-status month when no workflow)

slas.label: 23B UL Step 3
slas.name: Unit adjustments
slas.statement: 'Workflow for Unit Adjustment': Created Date vs Close Date, using the 3 pm rule.

slas.label: 23C
slas.name: Cancellations
slas.statement: Cancellations for 360 Protect, Business Protection, Income Protection and Mortgage Protection: matched 'Approve Cancellation' Created Date vs the cancellation's last-status time; met if under 48 hours.

slas.label: 23E
slas.name: Unrecognised EFT payments
slas.statement: Manual Review workflows whose description contains 'EFT Payment Not Recognised': closed the same or next business day.
